title: Hardware Design Engineer
summary: Hardware design engineers design the electronic circuit boards inside products such as vehicle control units (ECUs), industrial controllers and medical devices: they draw schematics, pick parts and guide the PCB (printed circuit board) layout. They sit in a product hardware team with firmware, mechanical and test engineers and take each board from first prototype to production.
dailyDuties: Draw and review schematics for new boards
Select components and keep the bill of materials up to date
Work with the layout engineer on stack-up, routing and DFM fixes
Bring up prototype boards in the lab with oscilloscopes and power analysers
Simulate power supply and analog stages before layout
Fix EMI/EMC and signal problems found in testing
Write design and test reports for each hardware release

skills.expectation: Draw schematics and guide multilayer PCB layout in Altium, OrCAD or a similar tool
Design power supplies and analog stages and check them in circuit simulation
Design the digital side of a board: clocks, resets, logic and memory interfaces
Pick and wire up the microcontroller or processor at the heart of the board
Add UART, SPI, I2C, CAN and Ethernet interfaces to the board
Bring up new boards in the lab with an oscilloscope and logic analyser
Design boards that pass EMI/EMC tests and keep high-speed signals clean
Do hardware safety analysis such as FMEDA for ISO 26262 ECUs
Write small test firmware to check a new board
Put an FPGA on the board and work with the FPGA team
Test ECU networks with CANoe or similar tools
Script lab tests and data logging
Lead a small hardware team and review their schematics
